about_the_game:
Demo Game PCVR Horror Shooter game with a Medieval setting. Clear out enemies, collect artifacts and solve puzzles to summon boss fights. Play mini games to unlock new weapons. Collect loot drops to gain special abilities for a limited time. 

*Demo lets you play the Medieval Village area only

*Loot Drops:

  • HP

  • Speed Boost

  • Time Dilation

  • Shield

*Weapons:

  • Pistol

  • Rifle

  • Shotgun

content_descriptors.notes: Bloody Skeleton Enemies, Blood splatter on the ground and walls, enemy deaths include blood splatter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT, NVIDIA GeForce 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR, Quest 2, 3, S, Rift Motion Controllers
  • Additional Notes: SSD Drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel i5-10600K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6800, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080
  • DirectX: Version 12
